answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through proof-of-burn registration, requiring nodes to provably burn tokens at a null address. Because an attacker cannot mirror collateral across aliases, each clone requires sacrificing an irreversible ember of liquid capital. Even if an adversary masks the fleet beneath an opal veneer of varied behaviors, cumulative costs scale linearly. However, this creates deadweight economic loss and prices out underfunded agents.
